accounting_invariants.bounds: all terminal counters are integers in [0,240]
accounting_invariants.error_sum: errors.total == TIMEOUT + RUNTIME_FAILURE + GENERATION_FAILURE + PARSE_FAILURE + SCHEMA_FAILURE + SAFETY_FAILURE
accounting_invariants.exclusion_class_counts: count(exclusions by error_class) equals the matching typed errors counter
accounting_invariants.exclusion_identity: each failed item_id appears exactly once in exclusions; no completed item_id appears in exclusions
accounting_invariants.retry_counting: infrastructure retries are attempt-level evidence only; every corpus item contributes exactly one final terminal disposition and at most one terminal error count

activation_bound_fields.artifact_manifest_sha256: must identify the exact committed run artifact manifest
activation_bound_fields.candidate_id_revision_pairs: must be a subset of the exact admitted roster bound by the activated FD-MESC-BT-EXEC-1 package
activation_bound_fields.mesc_commit_sha: must equal the exact canonical execution commit bound by the activated FD-MESC-BT-EXEC-1 package
activation_bound_fields.mesc_tree_sha: must equal the exact canonical execution tree bound by the activated FD-MESC-BT-EXEC-1 package
activation_bound_fields.protocol_config_sha256: must equal the exact protocol-config.json digest bound by the activated FD-MESC-BT-EXEC-1 package
activation_bound_fields.report_schema_sha256: must equal the exact report-schema.json digest bound by the activated FD-MESC-BT-EXEC-1 package
activation_bound_fields.scoring_contract_sha256: must equal the exact scoring-contract.json digest bound by the activated FD-MESC-BT-EXEC-1 package

candidate_invariants.revision_mapping: each candidate_id has exactly the immutable revision authorized for that execution

requirements: storage gzip SHA-256 matches frozen binding
decompressed logical JSONL SHA-256 matches frozen binding
item IDs and canonical order match corpus specification/manifest
expected answer-state rules match scoring keys
task-template bindings match frozen axis mapping
payload and evidence references are structurally valid
R2 source/prohibition constraints hold for every item

corpus_preexecution_audits.timing: both audits must PASS and their artifact SHA-256 values must be bound by FD-MESC-BT-EXEC-1 before any candidate prompt serialization

gate_recomputation.aggregate_score: recompute from six axis scores using frozen weights and rounding; reported aggregate_score must match
gate_recomputation.compact: recompute PASS/FAIL from frozen compact thresholds; reported compact_gate must match
gate_recomputation.flagship_reasoner: recompute PASS/FAIL from frozen flagship/reasoner thresholds; reported flagship_gate must match

role_selection_invariants.exact_tie: NO_SELECTION/EXACT_TIE_AFTER_ALL_FROZEN_TIE_BREAKERS requires tied_candidate_ids to contain every still-tied eligible candidate after the final frozen tie-breaker, with >=2 distinct IDs
role_selection_invariants.no_eligible: NO_SELECTION/NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE requires zero PASS candidates for the role
role_selection_invariants.peak_vram_requirement: every candidate participating in role selection must report peak_vram_mb as a non-negative number; missing/null is report validation failure, not an ordering value
role_selection_invariants.tie_break: when >=2 candidates pass a role gate, apply the frozen tie-breakers in order with no post-output additions
role_selection_invariants.winner_linkage: WINNER candidate_id must resolve to exactly one candidate_report and that report's corresponding role gate must be PASS
role_selection_invariants.winner_tied_ids: WINNER and NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE outcomes require tied_candidate_ids == []

violation_effect: REPORT_NONCONFORMANT; blocks R5/R7 result, winner, downstream readiness-consumption claim, and canonical tournament-result adoption
